messages:
Maria_Ng: FYI overflow of security findings from the nightly SBOM scan — grouping around vLLM/Triton kernels and a protobuf/sentencepiece combo.
Samir_Khan: hitting CVE-2026-0421 in FlashAttention kernels and CVE-2025-9876 in protobuf reported by oss-scan. links?
Maria_Ng: https://oss-scan.example/CVE-2026-0421 and https://oss-scan.example/CVE-2025-9876 — both flagged as "remote code" escalation in specific kernel path and protobuf parsing.
sec-bot: Automated scan: package: flashattention, version: 2.1.0 -> advisory: CVE-2026-0421 (kernel OOB on GPU drivers). severity: HIGH. recommended: upgrade to 2.1.3 or apply vendor hotpatch.
Oliver_Ty: Can we confirm our Dedicated GPU images use flashattention 2.1.0? I thought Dedicated was pinned to 2.0.x for stability.
Dina_Ops: Dedicated kernels are pinned on the base image to flashattention 2.0.4, but some rollout nodes (canary) pulled 2.1.0 during last infra test. I'll run a quick inventory.
June_ML: vLLM stack depends on flashattention via wheel prebuilt for cuda12.1. We have a few private deployments that pulled the wheel directly.
Samir_Khan: protobuf CVE looks like parsing of crafted input in model metadata loader. Affects protobuf <= 3.20.2 per advisory. We have mixed installs: pip wheels in containers and system rpm on on-prem appliances.
Maria_Ng: Prioritization suggestion: 1) FlashAttention kernel CVE (CVE-2026-0421) for hosted and private canaries = P0 (kernel exploit). 2) Protobuf parsing (CVE-2025-9876) = P1 for hosted API (exposure limited) but P0 for Private on-prem where untrusted models could be dropped.
Dina_Ops: Agree. Proposed mitigation strategy: hotpatch canaries with kernel vendor patch + rollback path; block model uploads to private until protobuf patched in appliance images.
Oliver_Ty: On rollout details: can we do canary -> staged -> full with a forced fallback? We need a compatibility matrix: flashattention 2.1.3 binary + vLLM 0.7.4. If mismatch, fallback to software attention path (perf hit).
Samir_Khan: Action items: Samir to open infra ticket for canary hotpatch and rollback playbook. Maria to coordinate enterprise customers for private deployments and temporary upload block. June to run an eval harness with fuzzed model metadata to validate protobuf patch. Dina to inventory hosts and flag any 2.1.0 nodes.
Maria_Ng: Also KMS/audit note: blocklist unverified model uploads should be reflected in audit logs and generate an alert to sec@redwood when triggered. Who owns the alert rule?
Dina_Ops: I'll add rule to Alerting team runbook — event: model_upload.fail_unverified -> create incident P1 and tag with customer id.
Oliver_Ty: For Private deployments: we'll provide a remediation bundle (image + postinstall script) and an offline patch for air-gapped customers. Need KMS key rotation instructions if model metadata decrypt paths change.
Samir_Khan: Regarding RBAC: lock down model upload API to only "model-uploader" role temporarily. We'll push a short-lived RBAC change using feature flags. Samir will coordinate with platform to avoid breaking CI.
June_ML: I'll run regression prompts and a smoke eval on staging harness post-patch. If we see generation flakiness, we have a fallback to quantized model variant.
sec-bot: CVE tracker updated: CVE-2026-0421 assigned -> owner: Samir_Khan, due: 2143659180. CVE-2025-9876 assigned -> owner: June_ML, due: 2143659600.
Maria_Ng: Quick risk notes for stakeholder comms: hosted API risk surface low due to request filtering, Dedicated moderate, Private high. Recommend email template to Enterprise customers + support playbook. I'll draft.
Dina_Ops: Inventory result: 12 dedicated nodes had 2.1.0, 3 canaries. Marking them for immediate cordon.
Oliver_Ty: Cordoning now, switching canaries to software attention mode. watch cpu/gpu queue for latency spikes.
Samir_Khan: Samir here — opened infra ticket INF-5892 with rollback commands and kernel patch steps. Patching canaries now.
June_ML: Started fuzzing harness against patched protobuf build. Early results: parsing error fixed, no crashes so far.
Maria_Ng: Great. Let's sync in 30m in #incidents if canaries are stable. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
